pipe_nominal: PVC-U PN10 assumed procurement class, actual marking/rating must be verified
flow_direction: Reservoir -> strainer ->24V pump -> manifold ->12m span -> valve -> reservoir; relief and adjustable bypass return directly to reservoir
safety: No printed pressure-bearing fittings; all wetted components rated and inspected.
No valve between pump discharge and mechanical relief; pump switch is not the safety relief.
Pressure tests prohibited until weakest-part rating, relief flow/setpoint, gauge and pump curve are reviewed.
Low-voltage wet zone; certified isolated PSU/RCD mains connection by qualified person, no DIY mains wiring.
Latching DC pump stop, appropriately sized fuse, dry-run protection and independent isolation.
Leak cartridges are manufactured replaceable lab inserts with containment, not utility-pipe damage.
Gravimetric leak reference uses catch vessel/scale/timer; bulk meters not microleak reference.
